items.title: Awesome Mac
items.content_text:
### Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

*   [Sitch](https://phalladar.github.io/Sitch/) - Skitch-style screenshot annotation with tapered arrows, blur, and pixelate, fully offline. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/phalladar/Sitch) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")
*   [Snappy](https://beqaabu.github.io/Snappy/) - Open-source, Ubuntu-style screenshot tool with an adjustable selection, window and full-screen capture, markup, blur, and text copying. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/beqaabu/Snappy) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Input Methods / Audio Record and Process

*   [Keyameleon](https://keyameleon.app/) - Open-source tool that gives each physical keyboard its own input source and switches to it automatically as you type. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/mastro993/keyameleon) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Security Tools / Audio Record and Process

*   [Sentinel](https://sentinel-james-murphy.pages.dev/) - Plain-language Mac security-settings check with a Wi-Fi device list. ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

*   [Headroom](https://headroom-app.org) - Fast disk space analyzer with a treemap and duplicate finder that labels caches and developer folders Safe, Caution or Never before you delete them. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Ryware/Headroom) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Finder Tools

*   [Findly](https://findly.rocavence.com) - Finder-style file drawer that slides in from any screen edge with a hotkey and slides away when you switch apps. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/rocavence/Findly-app) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

items.title: Collective Ai Tools
items.content_text:
### App Builder

*   [Massvai](https://massvai.com/) - AI full-stack app builder that turns a prompt into a working Next.js app with database, auth and deployment. `#freemium`

### Data & BI

*   [Datacircle](https://datacircle.dev/) - Query your favorite B2B data APIs through us. Same request, same price, no markup. Use it from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor: add api.datacircle.dev/mcp as an MCP server. `#freemium` `#mcp`

### Developer Tools

*   [Archcore (⭐68)](https://github.com/archcore-ai/archcore) - Git-native context engineering and spec-driven development for AI coding agents. `#free` `#opensource`

### SEO

*   [Blawgy](https://blawgy.com/) - Writes and publishes SEO blog posts to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Framer, Ghost and Duda, with an MCP server so any AI agent can research keywords, manage the plan and publish. `#paid` `#seo`

### Summarizer

*   [ORANO](https://oranoai.com) - Turns saved Reels, TikToks, YouTube videos, articles and PDFs into searchable summaries and step-by-step plans. `#freemium`

### Video

*   [Sora2 Hub](https://sora2hub.org/) - AI image and video generation platform for text-to-video, image-to-video and text-to-image in one workspace. `#freemium`

items.title: Awesome Python
items.content_text:
### Projects / Documentation

*   [sphinx (⭐8.1k)](https://github.com/sphinx-doc/sphinx) - Python Documentation generator.
    *   [awesome-sphinxdoc (⭐978)](https://github.com/ygzgxyz/awesome-sphinxdoc)

### Projects / Distributed Computing

*   [ray (⭐44k)](https://github.com/ray-project/ray) - A unified framework for scaling AI and Python applications.

### Projects / Job Schedulers

*   Workflow Orchestration
    *   [temporalio (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-python) - Temporal SDK for durable, fault-tolerant workflows that survive crashes and retries.
    *   [dagster (⭐16k)](https://github.com/dagster-io/dagster) - An orchestration platform for the development, production, and observation of data assets.
    *   [apache-airflow (⭐47k)](https://github.com/apache/airflow) - Airflow is a platform to programmatically author, schedule and monitor workflows.
    *   [prefect (⭐24k)](https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect) - A modern workflow orchestration framework that makes it easy to build, schedule and monitor robust data pipelines.

### Projects / CLI Tools

*   Shells
    *   [xonsh (⭐9.7k)](https://github.com/xonsh/xonsh) - A Python-powered shell. Full-featured and cross-platform.

### Projects / GUI Development

*   Web-based
    *   [pywebview (⭐6.1k)](https://github.com/r0x0r/pywebview) - A lightweight cross-platform native wrapper around a webview component.
    *   [nicegui (⭐16k)](https://github.com/zauberzeug/nicegui) - An easy-to-use, Python-based UI framework, which shows up in your web browser.
    *   [flet (⭐17k)](https://github.com/flet-dev/flet) - Cross-platform GUI framework for building modern apps in pure Python.

### Projects / HTML Manipulation

*   [justhtml (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/EmilStenstrom/justhtml) - A pure Python HTML5 parser that sanitizes untrusted HTML by default.

### Projects / Package Repositories

*   [bandersnatch (⭐553)](https://github.com/pypa/bandersnatch) - PyPI mirroring tool provided by Python Packaging Authority (PyPA).

items.title: Open Source Flutter Apps
items.content_text:
### Productivity

*   [Orkas](https://openappscout.com/apps/orkas/) - Orkas is an open-source, local-first desktop AI workforce. A Commander turns goals into executable plans and coordinates specialist agents in parallel or sequence through one chat. ([Source (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas))
*   [Plainsay](https://openappscout.com/apps/plainsay/) - Plainsay is an MIT-licensed macOS dictation app that transcribes on-device with Whisper large-v3-turbo or Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3. Local mode is free, with no account and no telemetry. ([Source (⭐12)](https://github.com/conrader/plainsay))
*   [Tale](https://openappscout.com/apps/tale/) - Tale is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted project workspace for agent tasks, shared context and team review of reports and deliverables. ([Source (⭐34)](https://github.com/tale-project/tale))

### Developer Tools

*   [Open Reports](https://openappscout.com/apps/open-reports/) - Open Reports is an MIT-licensed web report designer and rendering engine for creating and rendering invoices, statements and other operational documents from JSON definitions. ([Source (⭐0)](https://github.com/varaprasadreddy9676/open-reports))

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### MCP Servers

*   [Blawgy (⭐2)](https://github.com/adamgusky/blawgy-mcp) - Run your SEO blog from Gemini CLI. Research keywords, manage the content plan, write and update SEO blog posts with images and internal links, publish them to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Framer, Ghost and Duda, and read Search Console traffic, rankings and indexing status. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source, included on every paid plan with a free trial. Add with `gemini mcp add --transport http blawgy https://app.blawgy.com/mcp`.
*   [DropTheHassle (⭐2)](https://github.com/bosmdavid-gif/dropthehassle-mcp) - Lets Gemini CLI publish the site it built on a real HTTPS link instead of localhost: a free link, no account needed. For your own .com it hands the human a €19/$19-a-year payment link; after payment the site goes live on it with no DNS. No tool spends money. For claimed sites, ask it for visitors, leads or site status. Remote Streamable HTTP, no sign-in for the first publish, or local stdio via `npx -y dropthehassle-mcp`. MIT. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http dropthehassle https://dropthehassle.com/mcp`.
